links.outcome: Inter-rater agreement among human physician reviewers used as reference for documentation quality
links.effect: Human reviewer overall score CCCs ranged from 0.28 to 0.86; inter-human pass/fail Kappa ranged from -0.12 to 0.68.
links.quote: Inter-rater agreement among human reviewers showed substantial variability, with overall score CCCs ranging from 0.28 to 0.86.

unlisted_practices: LLM-based automated quality assurance auditing of clinical documentation against peer review standards

screen.reason: Empirical pilot study evaluating an LLM-based system for automated quality assurance and audit of emergency department documentation against human physician reviewers.
